blurb: For almost a century, the University of Georgia has been a center of research in natural history related to the state, the region, and the world. To a large extent, the quality of this research is based upon the information and knowledge associated with the 11 collections affiliated with the Georgia Museum of Natural History. These collections represent research conducted in dozens of fields of study.
